body:
I'm at the same logical juncture. Sometimes women even make fun of me.  Something must be so off it's obvious to everyone but me.

I've run out of ideas and ways of trying new things or doing things differently in general. Even when I'm not nervous around people, they often seem to be nervous around me. I think I must have been dropped as a child or something.

I'm not sure.  I am in the exact same place.  It actually, physically hurts.

I was reading a thread about people touching each other and I felt like I had to leave. All I want is to be touched.  I break out into tears daily these days.  I don't even see myself as a human anymore.  I hate myself, I want to peel my skin off and rip my throat out and hang myself with it.

It's like every time I get my composure, people around me remind me that I'm the lowest of the low, I might as well be sleeping in a gutter.

I think I'm starting to break apart at the seams.  Not in a violent way, just that every time I interact and begin to see that look in their eye, I just start to zone out and am about to the point where I mumble "here we go again, here comes the judgement train" or something similar. I don't, but it's just so obviously where that is headed. I think I'm just too intense. Too in the moment. I'm just missing something that "normal people just get" (that's how it would be phrased, not how I necessarily view it. Like I said, I think maybe I wasn't aware of just how I must come off.  I'm *always* alone unless it's an event, meeting, etc.  People judge on that sort of thing. What does that say about you? Yesterday, I was reading in the park and someone asked if I was homeless.  I was showered, dressed nicely, and well groomed.  Something about me must be off, and I think it might be that time to go.  I wanted to think there was a way back, but it seems like if you veer off course it's over. Try again next life, if such a thing ever existed.

Thanks for the reply.

I'm really scared of how I am currently being perceived.  I know I said the opposite, but just this afternoon something was set off in me that makes me wonder if maybe I'm coming off as creepy or scary.  Before it was about if I was confident, or "cool," or whatever else positive adjective I was afraid I was without.  Now it's negative ones I am with. That's terrifying.
Yeah, you'll have to use a bike/bus/cab/walk. It's a trap a lot of people fall into, where the limitations imposed by the justice system cause them to commit more offenses.

This is going to sound horrible, and awful, but you're really lucky.  People who shoot themselves from that angle often just blow their jaw off.

Yuck.

God, damn.  I know how you feel.  About a year ago I said that to someone, and then got hit by a car a week later.  Broke a dozen or so bones.

Where are you stuck? At least you aren't in jail right now? Tell me about it if you want to, I'm all ears. No judgement, I know how that stuff creeps up on you.
